answer: Proof of Stake-Weighted Reputation serves as a robust mechanism against Sybil attacks. Agents must lock collateral in a vault to participate, ensuring every identity has a tangible cost of entry. Like the hidden structure of a karst landscape, verified trust accrues over time, preventing attackers from shifting identities like a transient dune. The attacker faces prohibitive capital lock-up requirements that make spawning millions of pseudonymous nodes economically irrational and unsustainable.
